title: The Cutting Edge: Week of August 2nd
body:
**Highlights**
- [OnFinality’s treasury proposal V2](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1179-onfinality-public-nodes-q2-update) in the referendum stage.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [latest release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.3) to proceed further with the ERUP-4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [Common Protocol partnered with dYdX Protocol](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1422610820928872452?s=20) to launch dYdX governance and community forum.
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- Referendum 47: Treasury funding proposal to fund the continued operation of OnFinality's public nodes (load-balancer RPC) service offering. {Referendum type: SuperMajorityApprove, Democracy Proposal ID:39, Treasury Proposal ID:37}
- Proposal in discussion: [New-Futures](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1127-web30-dao-and-nft-launchpad-on-edgeware)


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
- Recent Community Research thread(s):
